subject: Request: Expanded trial allowance for Streamline AI POC (wide-context)
messages:
From: Sophie Green <sophie@streamline.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@streamline.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial/promo request — POC needs larger context + higher TPM

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the Streamline team is excited about Redwood's latency and the KV cache behavior. We are lining up an internal POC next week to validate extraction quality on long transcripts. A few details:

- Production-like prompt sizes: average prompt ~60k tokens, up to 180k tokens for threaded documents.
- Peak request rate: ~3.5k TPM during batch imports; steady-state around 800-1,200 TPM.
- POC duration: 6 weeks, starting Apr 12.

The self-serve credits are helpful but won't cover this workload. Can Redwood provide an elevated trial allowance (prefunded credits) and a short-term TTL extension so we can run the POC without hitting quota limits? Ideally: 1.5M token credits and a 90-day trial window, or similar.

We can share a small sample dataset and a short SOW if that helps. Procurement (cc'd) will need the formal grant details for internal approval.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Green
Head of ML Ops, Streamline AI
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Trial/promo request — POC needs larger context + higher TPM

Lauren / Aditya — forwarding Streamline's ask. Key constraints: very large context windows (up to 180k tokens) and short burst TPMs (~3.5k). They want ~1.5M tokens and 90 days.

A few points for consideration:
- Cost impact: with their estimated TPM and context, our unit cost increases significantly. We should decide whether to issue as a promotional grant (non-refundable credit) or a timed reserved allowance.
- Risk controls: suggest locking to specific model(s) and enabling rate limits & auto-fallback to a smaller model if abuse detected.
- Approval path: can we approve up to 1.5M in self-serve credits or do we need a manager sign-off?

Naomi — attaching their sample prompts (they shared on a quick call). Can you estimate the expected token burn / projected cost for 6-week run at peak and steady-state?

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial/promo request — POC needs larger context + higher TPM

Ben / team — I reviewed the ask and Naomi's preliminary burn estimate. Recommendation: approve a scoped promotional grant with the following guardrails: 

- Grant: 1,250,000 token-equivalent credits, valid 75 days from issuance (start date Apr 12).
- Rate control: soft cap at 2,000 TPM with an allowed burst to 3,500 TPM for 3 hours/day; automated throttling if sustained above 3,000 TPM for >30m.
- Model bindings: restrict to rwd-widecontext-v1 and fallback to rwd-fast-small if errors spike.
- Reporting: weekly telemetry snapshot and a mid-POC sync with our Solutions Engineer.
- Legal/procurement: include a short non-monetary grant letter (no SLA, non-transferable).

Reasoning: 1.25M balances meaningful testing for their largest cases without open-ended exposure. 75-day window keeps us from long tail. If they convert to Dedicated, we can credit a portion of the grant.

Aditya — please confirm we can create this in self-serve as a promo grant and push the grant doc to procurement. Naomi — finalize the cost estimate for GA.

-Lauren
VP Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Trial/promo request — POC needs larger context + higher TPM

Hi Sophie / Tom — great news: we've approved a scoped promotional grant for Streamline's POC. Summary and next steps below.

What we've approved:
- Grant amount: 1,250,000 token-equivalent credits (applies to generation + embedding units as defined in the grant).
- Validity: 75 days from Apr 12, 2027 (expires Jun 26, 2027).
- Rate controls: soft cap 2,000 TPM; controlled burst allowances to 3,500 TPM for limited windows; automated throttling if sustained >3,000 TPM for >30 minutes.
- Model bindings & fallback: rwd-widecontext-v1 primary; fallback to rwd-fast-small on sustained errors.
- Reporting: weekly telemetry reports; a mid-POC check-in scheduled for Apr 26.

Attachments: POC-Allowance-Grant-20270405.pdf (formal grant letter), Streamline-prompt-samples.zip (their sample prompts).

Action items for Streamline:
1) Review the attached grant letter and return signed by procurement if accepted.
2) Share any final sample datasets and the exact start date (we have Apr 12 penciled).
3) Add your Redwood project ID so we can attach the credits in the console (we'll provide the grant code in a follow-up).

Aditya/Naomi — please create the grant in the promo system (code: STRM-APR-1250K) and confirm the internal setup: model bindings, throttle rules, and telemetry access. Once the grant is created I will send the code and grant instructions to procurement.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth POC.

Best,
